## Context
The Owner needs a precise answer: the day/month/year Python 3.12.0 was released and what was the most important new feature of that version. Use official Python sources only (python.org, PEPs, release blogs, docs.python.org). Cross-reference at least 2 sources.

### Python 3.12.0 Release Date
2 October 2023

### Principal Novidade
More flexible f-string parsing (PEP 701). Python 3.12 lifted nearly all restrictions that previously constrained f-string expressions: you can now reuse the same quote type as the enclosing f-string, write multi-line expressions with inline comments, and use backslashes and Unicode escape sequences inside f-string expressions. The implementation moved f-string parsing into the PEG parser, which also made error messages for f-strings significantly more precise. This was the most user-facing language improvement — it eliminated a daily friction point that every Python developer who formats strings had to work around.

- https://docs.python.org/3/whatsnew/3.12.html
- https://pythoninsider.blogspot.com/2023/10/python-3120-final-now-available.html
